messages.content_text:
jan 8 Notes:


Today I did not take any trades because volatility died after 10:15am and price was unreadable since es and nq were basically moving in opposite directions all morning.
,
Market instantly dumped off of market open on nasdaq and took overnight lows and going towards completing a 4h mmsm, but made a relative equal low with it. At the same time es hadn’t even taken out overnight lows.
,
My first trade was going to be a 5min rb that was the 10:00 candle. The problem was I was looking for a wt and even though the liquidity got swept the ce of the wick didn’t get hit so I didn’t enter. the 5min rb was still a valid trade and there was a good draw too. (Screenshot 1 & 2)
,
The other trade that I was looking for was a 4h cisd, it aligned with a 15m fvg, the 0.5 fib, and there was el too. There was a 1min rejection block to take too, but I didn’t take this trade because volatility was already low. (Screenshot 2 & 3)
,
